title: Bosna clinch Bosnian title and double on aggregate despite OT defeat in decider
description: KK Bosna BH Telecom are the 2025-26 Bosnian basketball champions, claiming the title and a domestic double on aggregate even as they lost the deciding game 100-97 in overtime to Igokea m:tel. The Sarajevo side had built the platform for the title in the first leg, winning 76-70. That nine-point cushion proved decisive: despite falling in the return leg after an extra period, Bosna prevailed 173-170 on aggregate to seal the championship and complete the double.
